resources.string: Gear\u00A03 holds from 14 to 27\u00A0km/h, so city pace needs hardly any shifts.
Gear\u00A02 holds from 9 to 21\u00A0km/h, so climbs need fewer shifts under load.
%1$s. Shifts up at %2$d, %3$d and %4$d\u00A0km/h, down at %5$d, %6$d and %7$d\u00A0km/h.
Shift points are always set in km/h.
The shift points on the bike can make it shift back and forth. Pick a profile or adjust them.
Ease off the pedals for a moment when the bike shifts. That spares the shifter.
Shifting down sits at least 2\u00A0km/h below shifting up. Points in the same direction are at least 3\u00A0km/h apart. The bike drops to gear\u00A01 at 5\u00A0km/h at the latest.
The values on the bike were not usable. You start from Standard.
Shift up: press Boost twice quickly while riding.
Shift down: hold the bell button and press Boost twice quickly.
When you stop, the bike shifts to gear\u00A01 by itself.
Holding Boost still gives extra power.
Your shift points stay stored for Automatic.
The bike did not take %1$s. It reports: %2$s.
The bike did not take the shift points. It reports: %1$s.
These shift points would make the bike shift back and forth. Nothing was sent.
Too many shift changes in a row. Reconnect to go on.
The region changed while saving. Check the shift points again.
While riding, a change applies at once: the bike may shift right away.
Applies to region %1$s (each region keeps its own).
Bright: that gear. Gap: the bike keeps the gear it came from. Underlined: your gear now.
The bike reports every shift point as 0\u00A0km/h. With that it shifts up to gear\u00A04 as soon as it rolls and starts off in gear\u00A04. Pick Standard.
Drag a point or tap it, then fine-tune with − and +.
Gear\u00A04 only comes above %1$d\u00A0km/h, past the assist limit of %2$d\u00A0km/h: so only without assist. Gear\u00A03 holds up to there.
Firmware\u00A0%1$s reports shifting values YABA does not know (%2$s). YABA changes nothing here.
Shift settings still on the bike after reconnecting (firmware\u00A0%1$s).
YABA last set %1$s, the bike now reports %2$s. Another app changed it, or the bike did not keep it.
The bike no longer has the shift points YABA wrote last time (wrote %1$s, now %2$s). Another app changed them, or the bike did not keep them.
Could not read the current shift settings. Nothing was sent.
The bike’s region is unknown, so YABA cannot tell which shift point slot is in use. Nothing was sent.
The region changed since you set these points. Nothing was sent; check them again.
